# watchpoint_oncall_schedule (Data Source)

Looks up a single on-call schedule by name within the tenant. Returns the scalar schedule fields only; participants are not included.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "watchpoint_oncall_schedule" "example" {
  name = "Weekday Rotation"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the on-call schedule to look up (case-insensitive).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `id` (String) On-call schedule ID.
- `timezone` (String) Rotation anchor timestamp (RFC 3339) the schedule is anchored to.
